study.name: BANKING77 reliability replay v1, Valen-Decision-1.5
study.split: SHA-256(seed, normalized utterance hash) modulo 100: 0..29 calibration, 30..59 policy, 60..99 test

protocol.rendering: JevalKit retained request, all 77 candidates in source order

study.identity_verification: run metrics checksums verified predictions/manifest; every weight, config, tokenizer, processor and runtime-code hash the run recorded equals the Hugging Face repository at the recorded commit (LFS SHA-256 for weights and tokenizer.json, downloaded bytes for the other files) and the artifact hashes in the published Valen-Decision-1.5 Decision Index run manifest
limitations: Retrospective partition of a public benchmark already used in prior evaluations; not a fresh blind test.
No customer/conversation IDs; exact case/whitespace-normalized utterances stay together, semantic near duplicates are not certified absent.
Pretraining and adaptation overlap with BANKING77 cannot be ruled out.
English 77-way intent recognition only; not evidence for images, video, open-set rejection or production financial decisions.
Validation Wilson bounds are pointwise diagnostics; threshold search and distribution shift prevent a formal error guarantee.
study.prediction_source: JevalKit full runs with new native inference, 2026-11-10, NVIDIA H200; raw T=1
